items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He had Cliff King, and a guy named Wilson, Stanley Wilson on guitar, and a piano player named Antonia [Joe] Spaulding from Louisville, Kentucky. They were... That's who I was talking about. Spaulding.

ctx.x: A hackman. And he drove the hearse for the undertaking parlors. They called him "Joe Never Smile." Sit on this hearse... You had to have this beaver or this derby, and you'd sit on a hearse, and you had to not get emotionally aroused by nothin', because you had them kind of funerals where the wives and everybody go hysterical and they start screamin' and howlin' and runnin', and then
